stories.title: Harden explodes for 51, passes Kobe for third-most 50-point games all-time
stories.summary: James Harden posted the 26th 50-point game of his career, passing the late Kobe Bryant for third-most 50-point games in NBA history.

stories.title: Ballon d'Or winner Kane out a 'few months' after ankle injury in Bayern draw
stories.summary: Ballon d'Or winner Harry Kane is set to be out for several months after suffering a ligament tear in his left ankle during Bayern Munich's draw with Cologne.

stories.title: Reid offers Saints farewell: 'Things don't always go the way you planned'
stories.summary: The Saints have granted Justin Reid's request to be released, with the safety posting on social media: "In life and sports, things don't always go the way you planned or hoped they would."

stories.title: Gil, '24 AL Rookie of Year, cut loose by Yankees at MLB tender deadline
stories.summary: Veteran starting pitcher Luis Gil, 28, a former American League Rookie of the Year, was cut loose by the New York Yankees, among 44 players who became MLB free agents when their teams declined to offer 2027 contracts by Friday's tender deadline.

stories.title: Dodgers acquire versatile infielder Lewis in trade with Twins
stories.summary: The Dodgers acquired infielder Royce Lewis in a trade with the Twins, fulfilling Los Angeles' need for a versatile right-handed hitter to replace Miguel Rojas.
